We are building a strong research team and welcome applicants interested in our work.

There are no restrictions on academic background. Students in remote sensing, geographic information science, computer science, telecommunications, mathematics, and other disciplines are welcome to apply through recommendation or entrance examinations.

Please contact us early and prepare the following materials:
1. A CV covering your background, education and research experience, awards, skills, research interests and future plans, and self-assessment.
2. Academic transcripts.
